Watch runs in the foreground, delivering queued messages ("agent queue"),
until interrupted.

Every --interval it checks each agent that has a queued message, and delivers
the oldest one when the agent is idle, or back at its prompt after a failed
turn (error). It holds messages while an agent is processing or waiting, and
fails them once the agent's session has ended. Deliveries and failures are logged on
stderr.

Several watchers can run at once (each delivery is checked against the
agent's status), but one per host is enough. Each running watcher holds
.gomuxai/watch.lock, which is how queue knows whether one is running.

Usage:
  agent watch [flags]

Examples:
  agent watch
  agent watch --interval 5s

Flags:
  -h, --help                help for watch
      --interval duration   Check interval (default 2s)

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
